question: What's on the Coco Maya happy hour menu?
answer: The happy hour menu at Coco Maya in Little Italy has two parts. Food: a meatball sub (two meatballs, frankfurter roll, sauce, melted mozzarella), HH Pizza — Chefs Wim Pizza built to the chef's call each day, Girls Dinner (truffle fries and caesar), and fried chicken (two pieces with compressed watermelon). Cocktails: Oroma Espresso Martini or Carajillo, Main Character Energy (vodka, pear, orgeat, orange blossom water — an army-navy tiki riff), Out of Office (bourbon, peach, lemon, falernum, ginger beer — a Kentucky mule riff), and Gin-Othy (gin, pear cognac, spiced apple cordial, caramelized pineapple, lemon — a Washington apple riff).
